text.en: All laws or parts thereof inconsistent herewith are repealed or modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon the date of effectivity of Republic Act Numbered Eighteen hundred thirty-six, which has authorized the dual functions.
Approved: May 31, 1961.
